title: Mindtwitch Interactive website, 2008
lede: A 2008 portfolio site for interactive designer Michael Boucher, dressed in aged paper, rusted metal, torn edges, and stencil tabs.
summary: Stained parchment panels with torn edges on dark leather, rusty bands, red stencil tabs, and a taped photograph.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 from the Wayback Machine copy of 9 March 2008, and inspected. Nothing covers the page.

styles.note: Borderline: a clear example of later grunge web surfaces (stains, torn paper, rust, tape), but its HTML type is clean Georgia and Trebuchet, with damage only in image headings.

context: Smashing Magazine’s March 2008 article “The Secrets of Grunge Design” links mindtwitch.com among its examples. [Smashing Magazine](https://www.smashingmagazine.com/2008/03/the-secrets-of-grunge-design/).
observed: The page sits on a dark brown leather texture. The central column is made of stained, yellowed parchment with torn, curled edges.
A frayed cloth and paper strip at the top carries the “mindtwitch” wordmark with a red star and the tagline “CREATIVELY TWISTED”.
Navigation tabs are dark red with beige stencil capitals (“CREATIONS”, “EXPERIENCE”, “THE BLOG”).
A rusted metal band runs across the page below the tabs and again at the foot.
A photograph of a figure in a gas mask is mounted in a white frame held by strips of tape.
The heading “Creations” is a red brush script over a faded, larger copy of itself; body text is a plain serif list in black, blue, and red.
interpretation: The measurement finds only two families (Trebuchet MS and Georgia) and no pattern share, because every texture is a bitmap image (image share 1.0). This is typical of 2000s grunge web design: surfaces carry the style, and HTML type stays conventional.
borrow: Tear the edges of a content panel with an image mask and let a faded, oversized copy of the heading sit behind the heading.

images.alt: Mindtwitch home page from 2008: a stained parchment column with torn edges on dark leather, red navigation tabs with stencil lettering, a rusty metal band, a taped photograph of a person in a gas mask, and a red script heading Creations over a list of services.
images.caption: First viewport of the [Wayback Machine copy of mindtwitch.com, March 2008](https://web.archive.org/web/20080309122733/http://www.mindtwitch.com/).
